title: Obesity at antiretroviral therapy initiation and long-term risk of cardiovascular disease, cancer, or death in people with HIV in Italy: a prospective cohort study.
snippet: Altered adipose tissue biology plays a key role in the development of cardiovascular disease (CVD) and cancer and contributes to mortality. We assessed the association between obesity in people with HIV (PWH) at antiretroviral therapy (ART) initiation and the risk of clinical events.
